# Saved releases

Each golden file, `golden/<provider>-<source>.json`, is what the kind stores from a source's golden pair (`go test ./plugins/apisurface -update`): `openai-python-surface.json` from openai 1.1.1 → 1.1.2 (`apisurface_test.go`), the others from the pairs in `pypi_test.go` and `npm_test.go`, read from `pypi/<package>/` and `npm/<package>/`.
